notes.scope: Categorical criteria only; latency and freshness are scored continuously by rescore_continuous.py within the aug12_2026 cohort.
notes.agreement: 20 of 21 platform-criterion cells unanimous; the only split was query-flex (6/5/5) over whether honored attribute key:value filters lift Phoenix to the top of the 4-6 'client-side aggregation' band.

consensus_justifications.completeness: All 10 checklist fields present for the 9-span time-assistant-mcp trace: LLM I/O, model, 1113/99 tokens, cost 0.004824, per-span latency, tool args AND results, intact span tree.
consensus_justifications.query-flex: Time/name/attribute/span_kind filters verified honored, but aggregation=false and free_sql_or_dsl=false — the spans endpoint self-describes as 'simple filters (no DSL)', so all analysis is client-side.
consensus_justifications.dx-friction: Single Bearer token, self-served OpenAPI spec, malformed start_time returned HTTP 422 naming loc [query, start_time]; held at 9 because traces are reconstructed client-side by grouping on context.trace_id.
consensus_justifications.auth-access: 200 on first correctly-formed call; no plan or scope gating observed.
consensus_justifications.pagination: Cursor mechanism (span Global ID in next_cursor), second page actually fetched, documented 1000 page-size limit.
consensus_justifications.export-formats: Two formats actually received: json and otlp-json (typed OTLP key/value span payloads); CSV Accept header ignored, no columnar format.
consensus_justifications.otel-fidelity: Verbatim gen_ai.* semconv keys alongside OpenInference llm.* keys, 32-hex W3C trace ids, plus an OTLP-JSON export path.
